Answers that we believe must be heard. Frequently asked questions About 5% Niacinamide Body Wash Can I use niacinamide body wash every day? Yes, we recommend using this body wash for all skin types once a day, every day. Is niacinamide good for all skin types? Yes - this body wash can be used by all skin types. Can I use this twice a day? We recommend consulting an expert to verify the same. How much time will it take to see results? We recommend checking with an expert as results will vary depending on the condition: however you should start noticing a change within 3 months What does Niacinamide do for skin? Niacinamide helps repair the protective layer of the skin. It promotes the production of ceramides and elastin. Over time it helps reduce melanin transfer to outer layer of skin, which helps fade marks. Does niacinamide bleach skin? No, Niacinamide doesn't bleach skin.
